detail.longDescription: 🦖 @supports CSS at-rule ✅ Widely available (from Sept 2015) https:// developer.mozilla.org/en-US/do cs/Web/CSS/Reference/At-rules/@supports The @supports CSS at-rule lets you specify CSS declarations that depend on a browser's support for CSS features. Using this at-rule is commonly called a feature query. The rule must be placed at the top level of your code or nested inside any other conditional group at-rule. # webdev # CSS
